title.en: What Kind of City Wanderer Are You?
title.zh: 在城市里闲逛，你会沿什么线索走？

description.en: Six city-walk choices reveal the thread you follow: spatial patterns, neighborhood rhythms, or layers of local stories. All original portraits free.
description.zh: 6道城市闲逛选择题，看看你会追踪空间结构、街区节奏，还是地方故事的层次。原创完整画像免费。

title.en: What Kind of Coffee Break Do You Actually Want?

description.en: A six-question break-time quiz about a change of scene, a small sensory ritual, or easy company. No coffee required and no health claims.
description.zh: 6道小憩情境题，看看你更想换个场景、享受一个感官小仪式，还是找人轻松聊聊。不必喝咖啡，不涉及健康判断。

title.en: What Kind of Desk Reset Fits You?
title.zh: 你的桌面想怎样重新开始？

description.en: Six creative-workspace choices find your reset portrait: ready stations, a portable kit, or a clear stage. A playful preference quiz, not an organization grade.
description.zh: 6道创作桌面选择题，看看你更适合准备好的小站、可移动工具包，还是一块清爽舞台。不评判整洁能力，完整结果免费。

title.en: What Is Your Fantasy Adventure Party Role?
title.zh: 奇幻冒险队里，你负责什么？

description.en: Choose through six original fantasy expedition scenes to find your party role: route scout, ward keeper, or spell tinkerer. All story results are free.
description.zh: 走过6个原创奇幻远行情境，看看你是探路斥候、结界守护者还是咒语修补师。所有故事结果免费。

title.en: What Is Your Group Chat Role?
title.zh: 你在群聊里是什么角色？

description.en: Six everyday messaging choices reveal your chat contribution: signal keeper, spark starter, or quiet connector. Free full results without an account.
description.zh: 6道日常聊天题，看看你更像信息整理员、话题点火者还是安静的连接者。无需账户，完整结果免费。

title.en: What Kind of Kitchen Improviser Are You?
title.zh: 厨房临场发挥时，你是哪一派？

description.en: Six fictional dinner decisions explore how you adapt when ingredients, time, and tastes do not line up. Find your improvising style, not a cooking skill grade.
description.zh: 6道虚构晚餐选择题，看看食材、时间和口味对不上时，你怎样调整。不评价厨艺，完整结果免费。

title.en: What Is Your Missing-Keys Search Style?
title.zh: 钥匙一时找不到，你会怎么找？

description.en: Six harmless misplaced-object scenes explore your search story: replay the sequence, scan the space, or use another perspective. This is not a memory or ability test.
description.zh: 6道物品暂时找不到的小情境，看看你会回放经过、扫描空间，还是借助另一种视角。不测试记忆力或能力，完整结果免费。

title.en: The Lost Letter: Which Story Ending Will You Choose?
title.zh: 失落的信：你会走向哪种故事结局？

description.en: A free two-to-three-choice branching adventure at a floating post office. Follow your own route to an original ending, with no random outcome.
description.zh: 在漂浮邮局完成2至3次选择，沿真正的故事分支走向原创结局。无随机抽取，完整结局免费。

title.en: What Kind of Museum Visitor Are You?
title.zh: 逛博物馆时，你会怎样看？

description.en: Six exhibit choices reveal your visiting rhythm: looking closely, following connections, or making meaning together. Free portraits for a more personal museum day.
description.zh: 6道展览情境题，看看你偏向细看一件、追踪关联，还是与人共同理解。免费获得更贴近自己的观展画像。

title.en: What Kind of Playlist Maker Are You?
title.zh: 你的歌单会怎样照顾一段时间？

description.en: Six playlist decisions explore three original curating styles: a story arc, shared-room energy, or surprising discoveries. No genre stereotypes or copyrighted song excerpts.
description.zh: 6道歌单选择题，探索故事弧线、照顾现场或发现惊喜三种策划方式。不按曲风贴人格标签，不使用歌曲摘录。

title.zh: 你会用什么方式走进一本书？

description.en: Six recreational reading scenes explore how you choose, pause, and return: one world, a trail of books, or a small recurring appointment. Full results free.
description.zh: 6道休闲阅读情境题，看看你如何选书、停下与重新回来：沉入一个世界、串起几本书，还是保留小小的阅读约定。完整结果免费。

title.en: What Kind of Souvenir Story Do You Keep?

description.en: Six keepsake choices explore what makes a reminder meaningful: continued use, a specific memory, or a story shared with someone. No purchase required.
description.zh: 6道纪念物选择题，看看什么让提醒变得有意义：继续使用、一段具体记忆，还是与人共享的故事。不必购物，完整结果免费。

description.en: Six low-stakes planning scenes explore what makes a weekend feel yours: a few anchors, room for surprises, or protected breathing space. All results free.
description.zh: 6道轻松的安排题，看看怎样的周末更有自己的感觉：有几个锚点、容纳惊喜，还是守住留白。完整结果免费。

title.en: Which Woodland Animal Matches Your Trail Style?
title.zh: 你的林间同行动物是什么？

description.en: A free six-question woodland animal quiz about exploring, making a base, and protecting your pace. Read your complete animal portrait immediately.
description.zh: 6道林间情境题，看看你更像开路、搭窝还是留意节奏的同行动物。免费查看完整画像。
